transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As you know, the Product Support and Customer Education teams recently merged, and I'm organizing a two-hour workshop to help us establish effective working relationships. Before I finalize the arrangements, our routine planning check-in requires me to gather input from each stakeholder. I'd like everyone to share any relevant commitments, access needs, or process requirements you have. Specifically, I need to know: (1) Your availability on October 9th from 13:00 to 15:00 and/or October 10th from 10:00 to 12:00, (2) Whether you'd prefer the workshop to be entirely in person or if you need a remote participation option, and (3) Any other access needs or process requirements I should be aware of. I'm also considering Jordan and Priya as possible facilitators, so if either of you has a preference or concern about that, please let me know. Once I hear from everyone, I'll make the final arrangements. What are your thoughts?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let everyone know — I've already agreed in a separate employee-network planning thread to facilitate the workshop on October 10th from 10:00 to 12:00, and I won't be available to facilitate the October 9th slot. That agreement wasn't carried over into Elena's workshop draft, so I want to make sure it's on the record now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share an access need. I have an approved hearing accommodation that requires remote participation with live captions, and at least 48 hours of agenda notice. I haven't yet requested that this specific workshop use the accommodation, but I'm requesting it now. So I'll need the remote participation option, and I'd appreciate receiving the agenda at least 48 hours in advance. Regarding availability, I can make either the October 9th 13:00-15:00 slot or the October 10th 10:00-12:00 slot work. As for facilitation, I'm comfortable serving as a facilitator if that works for the group, but I also want to make sure my accommodation needs are factored into that decision.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Before Elena finalizes the workshop, I need to share an important HR requirement I confirmed this week. For a post-merger relationship workshop like this one, HR policy requires three things: (1) the workshop must not be recorded, (2) it must accept anonymous questions, and (3) a written response memo must be published within 5 business days. I haven't added this guidance to Elena's draft yet, so I want to make sure it's on the record now so it can be incorporated into the final arrangements.
